ideas.pitch: An edge-computed traffic light synchronization and air pollution mitigation dashboard designed for smart cities.
ideas.title: UrbanFlow AI - Smart Traffic & Air Quality Corridor Optimization
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Smart & Sustainable Cities track with measurable environmental impact, mirroring the satellite monitoring success seen in GeoNex-ATLAS.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning predictive model forecasting localized municipal grid loads and renewable energy surpluses.
ideas.title: EcoGrid AI - Urban Energy Consumption Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes rigorous statistical forecasting and calibrated confidence intervals, directly drawing from the winning methodology of Apart Research AI Forecasting.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered computer vision and multi-agent pipeline that ingests citizen complaints, detects potholes and streetlamp failures from photos, and auto-routes tickets with data lineage.
ideas.title: CivicSense - Automated Urban Infrastructure Issue Triager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical municipal utility with autonomous agent routing, a proven formula seen in the BlackBox DataHub Agent Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and sensor-stream analytics platform that monitors pipe pressure anomalies to flag municipal water leaks and contamination risks instantly.
ideas.title: AquaWatch - Real-Time Urban Water Contamination & Leak Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses critical infrastructure vulnerabilities in modern urban centers with a live, working telemetry dashboard that impresses judges evaluating tangible prototypes.

ideas.pitch: A geospatial design tool that analyzes satellite imagery and roof surface temperatures to recommend optimal locations for green roofing interventions.
ideas.title: GreenRoof AI - Urban Heat Island Mitigation Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides concrete ecological benefits with quantifiable temperature reduction metrics, appealing directly to sustainability judges looking for actionable solutions.
